faqs.question: What is IPFlex AI Accelerator?
faqs.answer: It is a network optimization service for overseas AI tools, combining residential IPs, smart DNS management, and WebRTC protection.

faqs.question: Will it affect local websites and apps?
faqs.answer: No. It focuses on overseas AI service access while keeping normal local website usage unaffected.

faqs.question: Why use static residential IPs?
faqs.answer: Residential IPs are assigned by ISPs and usually carry a more trusted identity than datacenter IPs.

faqs.question: Why do DNS and WebRTC protection matter?
faqs.answer: DNS queries and WebRTC can expose real network signals even when the exit IP looks clean. The client reduces these leaks.

faqs.question: Which operating systems are supported?
faqs.answer: Windows 10/11 and macOS 12+ are currently supported.

faqs.question: Can I use multiple devices?
faqs.answer: Yes. Purchased IPs can sync across devices logged in with the same account.
